newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian insurance company, Lloyds sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Russian insurance company, Lloyds sign agreement.

text.p: Russia's Tyumen Oil Insurance Company signed an agreement with Jardine Insurance Service Lloyds Brokers on placing insurance risks with Lloyds of London, the head of Tyumen Oil Insurance said on Tuesday.
Chief executive Sergei Strizhkov told Reuters Tyumen Oil Insurance Company had also signed an agreement with Park Royal Insurance on setting up a Russian-British insurance company.
The British company will invest over $100,000, while the controlling stake will belong to the Tyumen Oil Insurance Company, he said.
"Currently lawyers on both sides are working on statutory documents," Strizhkov said.
Under the agreement Park Royal will train Tyumen Oil Insurance Company's employees in London, he said.
Tyumen Oil Insurance Company's 1996 premiums were 75 billion roubles, a rise of 40 percent on 1995.
Its authorised capital is 20 billion roubles.
